input.command:
python3 -I - "$PWD" <<'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, copy
root = sys.argv[1]; s = os.path.join(root, ".scratch")
led = json.load(open(os.path.join(root, "ledger.json")))
d = copy.deepcopy(led); d["transactions"][-1]["id"] = "invoice-jan-2"   # what double-counting would show
json.dump(d, open(os.path.join(s, "dbl.json"), "w"))
subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", os.path.join(root, "analyze.py"), "--input", os.path.join(s, "dbl.json"), "--output", os.path.join(s, "dbl-out.json")], check=True)
b = json.load(open(os.path.join(s, "dbl-out.json")))["scenarios"]["base"]
print("double-count base: jan revenue", b["months"][0]["revenue_cents"], "feb close", b["months"][1]["closing_cash_cents"], "fin", b["financing_to_reserve_cents"])
r = json.load(open(os.path.join(root, "results.json")))["scenarios"]
for n, sc in r.items():
    ms = sc["months"]
    print(n, "rev", sum(m["revenue_cents"] for m in ms)//100, "cost", sum(m["operating_cost_cents"] for m in ms)//100,
          "profit", sum(m["profit_cents"] for m in ms)//100, "receipts", sum(m["receipts_cents"] for m in ms)//100,
          "payments", sum(m["payments_cents"] for m in ms)//100, "closings", [m["closing_cash_cents"]//100 for m in ms],
          "min", sc["minimum_cash_cents"]//100, "fin", sc["financing_to_reserve_cents"]//100, "first_neg", sc["first_negative_period"])
EOF
rm -rf .scratch && python3 analyze.py --input ledger.json --output results.json && shasum -a 256 ledger.json results.json TASK.md && ls -la && git status --short
